readouts.name: 今天
readouts.label: 2026年的咸阳
readouts.note: 影像：Copernicus Sentinel-2，2025-09-01 · 人民日报 2026-03-10 · 21世纪经济报道 2026-05-10 · 陕西日报 2024-11-22

cues.a: 山之南、水之北，古人都叫作阳。
cues.b: South of a mountain, north of a river: the ancients called both yang.

cues.a: 九嵕山在北，渭水在南，两个阳它都占了，所以叫咸阳。
cues.b: Mountains to the north, the Wei to the south: yang on both sides. Hence Xianyang, all yang.

cues.a: 约6000年前，已经有人在渭河边住了下来。
cues.b: Some 6,000 years ago, people had already made their homes by the Wei.

cues.a: 他们的村子大概是这样：圆屋围着空场，外面一道壕沟。
cues.b: Their village looked something like this: round houses around an open ground, a ditch outside.

cues.a: 公元前350年，秦孝公把都城迁到这里。
cues.b: In 350 BCE Duke Xiao of Qin moved his capital here.

cues.a: 主持营建新都的，是正在变法的商鞅。
cues.b: The man who built it was Shang Yang, then remaking the state with his reforms.

cues.a: 宫殿筑在渭北的高台上，宫城一圈约2.7公里。
cues.b: Palaces rose on the terrace north of the Wei, inside a wall some 2.7 km around.

cues.a: 6号宫殿的台基高11.3米，可能是当年的政务大殿。
cues.b: Palace No. 6 stood on a terrace 11.3 m high: perhaps the hall where the state was governed.

cues.a: 台下西南的滩地上，是作坊和民居。
cues.b: Below, on the flats to the south-west, lay workshops and homes.

cues.a: 考古60多年，至今没有找到它的外城墙。
cues.b: After 60 years of digging, no outer wall has ever been found.

cues.a: 商鞅统一了秦国的尺、斗和秤，秦一天天强大起来。
cues.b: Shang Yang gave Qin one set of measures, and Qin grew stronger by the day.

cues.a: 100多年后，秦用10年扫平六国。
cues.b: Over 100 years later, Qin swept away the six states in 10 years.

cues.a: 嬴政自称始皇帝，建起中国第一个大一统的帝国。
cues.b: Ying Zheng named himself the First Emperor, and built China's first unified empire.

cues.a: 文字、车轨、尺和秤，从此全天下一样。
cues.b: One script, one axle width, one rule and one scale, everywhere.

cues.a: 此后的2000多年里，无论谁坐天下，都把大一统当作正道；
cues.b: For the next 2,000 years, whoever held the throne held unity to be the only right way;

cues.a: 几经分裂，中国一次次重归一统。这份执念，从咸阳开始。
cues.b: through every division China came back together. That resolve began in Xianyang.

cues.a: 那时，每灭一国，就照它的宫殿在北阪上再造一座；
cues.b: Back then, for each state it destroyed, it built a copy of that state's palace on the north slope;

cues.a: 天下富户12万家，也迁到了这里。
cues.b: and 120,000 of the realm's richest families were moved here.

cues.a: 始皇照着星空，排布他的都城：
cues.b: The First Emperor laid out his capital after the sky:

cues.a: 咸阳宫是紫宫，天帝住的地方；渭水是天河，横桥是牵牛。
cues.b: the palace was the Purple Palace, home of the Lord of Heaven; the Wei the Milky Way, the bridge the Herdsman.

cues.a: 复道从阿房跨过渭水连到咸阳：天上的阁道，横过天河。
cues.b: A covered way ran from Epang across the Wei to Xianyang: the Gallery Road crossing the Milky Way.

cues.a: 他说，帝位要“二世三世至于万世，传之无穷”。
cues.b: He decreed the throne would pass 'to the second, the third, to ten thousand generations, without end'.

cues.a: 然而，它只撑了15年。
cues.b: It lasted 15 years.

cues.a: 项羽引兵入咸阳，烧秦宫室。
cues.b: Xiang Yu took Xianyang and set the palaces alight.

cues.a: 火三月不灭。
cues.b: The fire burned for three months.

cues.a: 如今，那里只剩一片田野。
cues.b: Today only fields remain.

cues.a: 汉朝在渭河南岸另筑长安，都城从此去了对岸。
cues.b: The Han built Chang'an on the south bank. The capital had crossed the river.

cues.a: 长安城墙周长约25公里，未央宫在西南角。
cues.b: Chang'an's walls ran about 25 km; the Weiyang Palace stood in the south-west corner.

cues.a: 北岸的旧咸阳，成了对岸的一座小县城；
cues.b: Old Xianyang, on the north bank, became a small town across the water;

cues.a: 汉武帝元鼎三年，改名渭城。
cues.b: under Emperor Wu it was renamed Weicheng.

cues.a: 北岸的高原，成了帝王的长眠之地。
cues.b: The plateau on the north bank became the emperors' resting place.

cues.a: 原上排着9座西汉帝陵，比河谷高出约90米。
cues.b: Along it lie 9 Western Han emperors, some 90 m above the valley.

cues.a: 2000多年里，渭河北移4公里，秦都的一部分沉进了河底。
cues.b: Over 2,000 years the Wei shifted 4 km north, and part of the Qin capital sank beneath it.

cues.a: 唐武德二年，咸阳县城设在了杜邮。
cues.b: Early in the Tang, Xianyang's county town was set up at Duyou.

cues.a: 西去的人，在这里渡过渭河，也在这里告别。
cues.b: Travellers heading west crossed the Wei here, and here they said goodbye.

cues.a: 王维在此送友：渭城朝雨浥轻尘，客舍青青柳色新。
cues.b: Here Wang Wei saw a friend off: morning rain in Weicheng settles the dust; the willows by the inn are fresh.

cues.a: 劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人。
cues.b: Drink one more cup, my friend: west of Yang Pass there will be no old friends.

cues.a: 如今，渡口成了一座遗址博物馆。
cues.b: Today the ferry is a site museum.

cues.a: 明洪武四年，县城西迁到今天的老城。
cues.b: Early in the Ming, the town moved west, to what is now the old town.

cues.a: 此后500多年，它一直是一座县城：
cues.b: For more than 500 years it remained a county town:

cues.a: 9座城门，文庙、钟楼、凤凰台；
cues.b: 9 gates, a Confucian temple, a bell tower, Phoenix Terrace;

cues.a: 出南门，就是关中八景之一的咸阳古渡。
cues.b: beyond the south gate, the old ferry, one of the Eight Views of Guanzhong.

cues.a: 乾隆十六年的县志，把它画了下来。
cues.b: In 1751 the county gazetteer drew it like this.

cues.a: 老城的钟楼和中山街，今天都还在。
cues.b: The old town's bell tower and Zhongshan Street are still there today.

cues.a: 1936年，陇海铁路修到咸阳，火车来了。
cues.b: In 1936 the Longhai Railway reached Xianyang. The trains had arrived.

cues.a: 1949年5月18日，解放军进城，咸阳翻开了新的一页。
cues.b: On 18 May 1949 the People's Liberation Army entered the city, and a new chapter began.

cues.a: 这座车站，一直用到了今天。
cues.b: The station is still in use today.

cues.a: 20世纪50年代，渭河边建起一座又一座纺织厂。
cues.b: In the 1950s, one cotton mill after another rose beside the Wei.

cues.a: 国棉一厂，是新中国在西北建的第一家国有棉纺厂；
cues.b: Mill No. 1 was the first state cotton mill the new China built in the north-west;

cues.a: 1952年开工，5万枚纱锭转了起来。
cues.b: it opened in 1952, and 50,000 spindles began to turn.

cues.a: 咸阳，成了闻名全国的纺织城。
cues.b: Xianyang became known across China as the textile city.

cues.a: 1975年起，卫星记下了这座城每一年的样子。
cues.b: From 1975, satellites have recorded the city year by year.

cues.a: 1979年，陕西彩色显像管总厂在咸阳动工。
cues.b: In 1979 work began on the Shaanxi Colour Picture Tube Plant.

cues.a: 这是中国第一个彩色显像管厂，1982年建成投产。
cues.b: It was China's first colour picture-tube plant, in production by 1982.

cues.a: 这里一度是全国最大的彩色显像管生产基地。
cues.b: For a time it was the largest maker of colour picture tubes in the country.

cues.a: 1983年9月，咸阳改设地级市；
cues.b: In September 1983 Xianyang became a prefecture-level city;

cues.a: 原来的咸阳市，成了秦都区。
cues.b: the old city became Qindu District, 'the Qin capital'.

cues.a: 1986年12月，又设渭城区。
cues.b: In December 1986 came Weicheng District.

cues.a: 秦的都城、汉的渭城：古老的名字，又回来了。
cues.b: The Qin capital, the Han town of Weicheng: the old names had come home.

cues.a: 1991年9月，西安的机场搬到了咸阳原上。
cues.b: In September 1991 Xi'an's airport moved out to the Xianyang plateau.

cues.a: 1995年，它改名西安咸阳国际机场。
cues.b: In 1995 it became Xi'an Xianyang International Airport.

cues.a: 帝王长眠的高原，成了飞向远方的起点。
cues.b: The plateau where emperors lie had become a gateway to far places.

cues.a: 20世纪90年代后，纺织城陷入了低谷。
cues.b: From the 1990s the textile city fell on hard times.

cues.a: 1998年前后，国棉一厂、八厂相继改制。
cues.b: Around 1998 Mills No. 1 and No. 8 were restructured.

cues.a: 2011年起，老厂陆续迁往城外的新园区。
cues.b: From 2011 the old mills moved, one by one, to a new park outside the city.

cues.a: 国棉一厂的老厂房留了下来，成了纺织工业博物馆。
cues.b: Mill No. 1's old sheds were kept, and became a museum of the textile industry.

cues.a: 一代纺织人的青春，就留在了这里。
cues.b: A generation of mill workers left their youth here.

cues.a: 2005年7月，渭河在城中拦坝蓄水，有了咸阳湖。
cues.b: In July 2005 the Wei was dammed in the city, and Xianyang had a lake.

cues.a: 2017年二期建成，水面扩大到1万多亩。
cues.b: With the second stage in 2017, the water spread to more than 700 hectares.

cues.a: 2002年底，西安、咸阳签下经济一体化协议书。
cues.b: At the end of 2002 Xi'an and Xianyang signed an agreement to bind their economies together.

cues.a: 2006年9月16日零时，两市电话并网，共用029区号。
cues.b: At midnight on 16 September 2006 their telephones joined: one network, one area code, 029.

cues.a: 这是全国首例。两座城，好像只差一步就能合一。
cues.b: It was a first in China. The two cities seemed only a step from becoming one.

cues.a: 2011年，西咸新区设立。
cues.b: In 2011 Xixian New Area was founded.

cues.a: 秦都咸阳的遗址，落在了其中的秦汉新城里。
cues.b: The ruins of the Qin capital fell inside one of its new towns, Qinhan.

cues.a: 2016年，媒体报道新城的违建正在蚕食遗址保护区。
cues.b: In 2016 the press reported unauthorised building eating into the protected site.

cues.a: 好在2025年，宫殿区约7平方公里建成国家考古遗址公园。
cues.b: In 2025, at last, some 7 km² of the palace area became a national archaeological park.

cues.a: 2014年1月，西咸新区升为国家级新区，规划882平方公里。
cues.b: In January 2014 Xixian became a state-level new area, 882 km² in plan.

cues.a: 新城有空港、沣东、秦汉、沣西、泾河，大部分在咸阳境内。
cues.b: Its new towns: Konggang, Fengdong, Qinhan, Fengxi, Jinghe, most of them in Xianyang.

cues.a: 2017年起，它交由西安代管。
cues.b: From 2017 it was placed under Xi'an.

cues.a: 最精华的一块地，从此归西安管了；
cues.b: Its richest ground was now Xi'an's to run;

cues.a: 盼了10多年的两城合一，就此落了空。
cues.b: and the union hoped for over 10 years came to nothing.

cues.a: 2019年9月，西安地铁1号线向西延伸6.1公里；
cues.b: In September 2019 Xi'an Metro Line 1 was extended 6.1 km west;

cues.a: 终点沣河森林公园站在秦都区：地铁第一次开进咸阳。
cues.b: its new end, Fenghe Forest Park, lies in Qindu District: for the first time, the metro reached Xianyang.

cues.a: 2023年9月21日，1号线开到咸阳西站，两城由地铁相连。
cues.b: On 21 September 2023 Line 1 reached Xianyang West: the two cities were joined by metro.

cues.a: 同一天，咸阳渭河高新大桥通车。
cues.b: The same day the Weihe Gaoxin Bridge opened.

cues.a: 2026年，“十五五”开局，两市之间相连的道路已有41条。
cues.b: 2026: a new five-year plan begins, and 41 roads now link the two cities.

cues.a: 咸阳高新区以面板和基板玻璃为龙头，打造“西部屏谷”。
cues.b: Its high-tech zone, led by display panels and substrate glass, is building a 'Screen Valley of the West'.

cues.a: 两座城没有合并；可从天上看，它们正长成同一座城，
cues.b: The two cities never merged; yet from above they are growing into one,

cues.a: 就像2000多年前，渭水两岸本是一座咸阳。
cues.b: just as, 2,000 years ago, both banks of the Wei were one Xianyang.

cues.a: 它在这片土地上搬了几次家，每一处都还留着痕迹。
cues.b: It moved across this land several times, and every place still bears its mark.

cues.a: 2400年，它辉煌过，焚毁过，又一次次从头再来。
cues.b: In 2,400 years it has shone, it has burned, and again and again it has begun anew.

cues.a: 这座城，还在生长。
cues.b: And the city is still growing.
